candidate_program.name: bounded_compatible_extrema
candidate_program.rationale: Modestly favors roots preserving a stronger compatible peak relative to their strongest conflicting rival. It reaches the full active complement through a maximum scan; repeated residual filtering costs CPU and the two extrema omit longer interactions.
candidate_program.rule: weight / (1 + degree) * (1 + 0.12 * (compatible_peak_ratio - max_conflict_weight / (1 + weight)) / (1 + compatible_peak_ratio + max_conflict_weight / (1 + weight)))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
